scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:production: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/copyzap run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.codegen: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run generate || echo 'Orval not available, skipping codegen'
